sanskrit: mahāsarasvatī devī tuṣṭā bhavati tadvadadaśaśloketi vikhyātaṃ vadāmi dhyānapūrvakaṃjvālāmālāsamāyuktāṃ devīṃ dhyāyeccaturbhujāṃsustanīṃ vedi madhyāṃ tāṃ caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharāṃkaṭake svarṇaratnāḍhyairmuktābalivibhūṣitāṃkaiyūrairmekhalādyaiśca dyotayaṃtīṃ jagatrayaṃśabdabrahmāraṇīṃ dhyāyejjñānakāmaḥ samāhitaḥpāṭhe viniyogaḥpraṇamya staumi tāmeva jñānaśakti sarasvatīṃnāmarūpātmikā vyaktā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīadvaitā brahmaṇaḥ śaktiḥ sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīanādinidhanānaṃtā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃdhyāyaṃti brahmarūpasthā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃnirvikalpātmikaikaiva sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃvyāpinī jñapti rūpaikā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃrudrādityādi rūpasthā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃpratyagāste vadaṃtī yā sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃsarvakāmadughādhenuḥ sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃyogīyāti paraṃ sthānaṃ sā māṃ pātu sarasvatīṃsobhyarcyaiva daśaślokyā bhaktyā stauti sarasvatīṃtataḥ pravartate vāṇī svechāyā lalitākṣarāaśrutaṃ budhyate graṃthaṃ prāyaḥ sārasvataḥ kaviḥprakhyātaḥ sarvalokeṣu vāgmī bhavati pūjitaḥsvayūthyairvedavāhyairvā vivāde prastute satievaṃ bhāvayatānena vācaspatirapi svayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na kāṃcana striyaṃ niṃden na devān nāpi vai dvijānanāryairnābhibhāṣeta sarvatraiva kṣamī bhavetślokaireva tiraskuryād dviṣaṃ taṃ prativādinamyadvāgiti dṛcenaiva devīṃ yorcayati sadātvaṃ bhūtasannidhiḥ sākṣādyauścaiva pṛthivī dhṛtiḥye tvāṃ māteti durgeti devāgarbheṃbike pareprātaścaivāparāhne ca stoṣyaṃtyānamramūrtayaḥkṣīredadhyupahāraiśca bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca pūjitānṛṇāmaśeṣakāmāṃstu prasannā sā prayacchatisā māṃ pātu sarasvatī bhagavatī niḥśeṣajāḍyāpahāsā me vāgdevate yaṃ nivasatu vadane sarvadā suprasannāsā me vasatu jihvāgre padmahastā sarasvatīmama vaktre vasennityaṃ dugdhakuṃdeṃdu nirmalāsadyaḥ suvāṃcchitaphalānyupayāti śighraṃnamātmānaṃ namāmyevaṃ nityanevāhamātmanāmaṃtrabhāṣyamidaṃ kḷptaṃ padavākyaiḥ suniścitaiḥupanayana prabhṛti brahmacārisyāḥsarvatrānuṣaṃgaḥsaṃhatakeśaḥ| vakṣamāṇaṃ dehādi damanaṃ kartuṃ sa tāṃ saṃgararcayetyupadiśatibhaikṣyacāryavṛttiḥnityamudyatamatirityarthaḥsaśalkvavaṃduḥnitya sāhacaritvātsaptamuṃjāṃmekhalāṃ dhārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato gurumupetyavedāntavākyavicāraḥ | śravaṇamananātmako dvitīyātṛtītataḥ paramaśivādvai tu sākṣātkāraṇaṃ caturthabhūmikājagato mithyātvāvabhāsātnivikalpakasamādhyavasthā lakṣaṇā asaṃsaktiḥ suṣuptiḥataḥ paraprayatnena vyutthānaṃsaṃbhavedityāhana madhumāṃsa ityādi || na madhumāṃse aśnīyāḥprārabdhasaṃskārabalādyathā | prāptaṃ bhuṃjīthā ityāhuḥkṣāralavaṇavarjisyāḥbhāvapradhānatvena nirdeśasya lāvaṇyaṃ varjayati | tacchīlaḥkṣareṣu tuchatva bhāvanayānīrasā ityarthaḥācāryasyā pratikkulaḥguroḥ brahmaika paratā bhāvaparyāya prātikūlya tyāgena sadṛśaḥsarvakāryāḥ svataṃtraḥsarvakāryeṣṭīśvarādhīnatvajñānena nirahaṃ matiḥpūrvotthāyīpūrvasminkaraṇe'jenidadhyāsaṃnāyoḥ yuktamatiḥjaghanyasaṃveśījaghanye paścādbhāvini kārye nāstīti | pratyayādanā saṃgena svapnaḥyattvāṃmupeyāttadasmaidadyāḥpracoditaṃ tadaṃtarmukhatve sakalaṃ vikalpitaṃ vilāpayeḥbahūnāṃ yena saṃyuktastadasmaidadyātetadbhāvaṃ sarvaṃ nayeḥnāsya śayyāmāviśeṣaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāvayanupadiśatinarathamāruheḥvastrasthānīyamiti | śaivaśāsanamāhana saṃvastrayethāgrāhyagrāhaka vaicitryeṇāvabuddhyeta itisarvāṇi sāṃsparśakāni strībhiḥ sahavarjayeḥprakṛtipuruṣavivekajñānaṃ sāṃkhyaśāstrasiddhasupadiśatina muṣitāṃ prekṣeḥbhāvaḥna vihārārtho jalpeḥviglāpanaṃ hi tat iti śruteḥna rucyarthaṃ kiṃcana dhārayethāḥnasnāyāḥprabhuḥudakaṃ vābhyupeyāḥviṣayakrīḍanātmakapakṣāṃtara vyāvṛtyarthaḥyadi snāyā daṃḍa evāpsu parilevethāḥyadi viṣayabhogaṃ vidadhyāḥ tarhi na tadraseṣvāsaktāḥ syāḥmuṃḍo jaṭilo śikhi vā bhavadvādaśāṃtordhagāminīsāyaṃ prātassaṃdhyāmupāsīthāḥpare tatve ca saṃdhānaṃ saṃdhyā iti ca kathyatetiṣṭhe pūrvāṃsaṃdhyāyāṃ tiṣṭheḥ | aṃtarmukhabhāve utthānamudyogaṃ vidadyāḥāsīthā uttarām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyutthāne vṛtti kuryā iti bhāvaḥoṃ bhūrbhuvasvarityuktvā | tatsavituriti sāvitrī manubrūyāḥbhāvayerityuktaṃ bhavatiprāgastamayā niṣkramya | samidha āhāre | hariṇī brahmavarcasakāmaḥśrūyatesāyaṃ prātassaṃdhyāni smaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃtadubhayavyāpakaṃ ca paraṃ tejaḥbhaikṣācaraṇaṃ kartavyamagnīṃdhanaṃ kartavyamtena ca brahmāgnerdīpanaṃ vidheyaṃsāyamevāgnirmaṃdhīthāḥbhaikṣasyācaraṇetyādi....................... bhaikṣācaraṇāgnīṃdhanīsaptarātrammābhūdityāśāste guruḥchṛṇu tu tvā vāksanamya dhārayatiyadvedabrataṃ tadatra bratambhavati | avaśyaṃ gṛhītavyamityarthaḥgururāhabrahmacārya'sītipaṃcavikārānanukramiruṣyāmaḥnavetyāśakyāhaapośānabrahmajñānavimarśadārḍhyaṃ bhavet tatrāha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karmaṇā bhavedityarthaḥ | kiṃ tatkarmetyapekṣāyāmāhadivāmāsuṣvāpsīḥnivārayanupadiśativācaṃ yaśchabhogyaciṃtādāyinamavidyāvatsaṃgaṃ tyājaya āhamāmalavadvāsodrākṣīḥeṣāṃ tān malavāsasaḥ na paśyeḥmāsaṃ bhāṣethāḥmalavadvāsaso bhavaṃtyudakyāḥ sūtikāḥ āśucayaḥ | aṃtyāvasāyina itiajñānasaṃgaṃ tyajedityarthaḥ bhāvaḥna śmaśānaṃ gacheḥabhimānaṃ tyajediti bhāvaḥna śavaśarī paśyeḥkiṃ vidheyamityāśaṃkyāhaanātṛṇaṃ śavaśarī dṛṣṭātrirātramupavaseḥnājñānāṃ spṛśetmadhumāṃse prāśyālabhya vā śarīraṃ punarbratamālabhethāḥrasikabhogyāveśo mama jāyate | kuta ityāhayāni havirdūṣaṇāni tāni bhojana ḍū?petuḥ ātmārpita sakala vyavahāro bhuṃjerityarthaḥnocchiṣṭa bhuṃjīthāḥpātyatikaraṇaṃnocchiṣṭamanyasmaidadhyaḥkathamanubhavanīyamityāśaṃkyāhakāmaṃ gurucchiṣṭamaśnīyāti hyācāryāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasaktaṃ bhodhikyaṃ pratiṣedhayatimā gurubhuṃjīthāvacanātvyādhitaviṣayametatityapekṣāyāmāhaārohatyevarviṣayāñcheyāṃstāṃstu parityajet || itinanuktaṃ bhuṃjethāḥpunarbhogabhāvanayeti bhāvaḥna mṛṇmaye bhuṃjīthāḥtānbhuṃjīthāḥ viṣayatyāgaṃ kuryādityarthaḥna pratisaṃdadhyā ityekeāhuḥsthānāsanaṃekatānatāvidheyetyarthaḥ | āsa upaveśanepūrvāṃtareṣūpavāso vāgyasanaṃ casyuḥ saṃbadhibahutvādbahuvacanaṃkiṃcidagni yataṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇāyāmaissaśuddhyatecidvimarśabāhulyenaiva śodhanaṃmiti yāvatsaṃdarśane trayaḥ kāryāḥśudhyāpatteḥsaṃvyāhṛtyātho saptapunaḥ pratyāhartavyamsamāsāya tu dvādaśasamāhitena bhāvyaṃ | kathametena śuddhatītyāśaṃkyāhasarvatra jyotirdarśanamudakopa sparśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhiheturityarthaḥ | kiṃtu jyotirityapekṣāyāmāhasūryācaṃdramasaugau agniḥ brāhmaṇa ityeṣāmekenāpi śuddhetisasādhyaṃ | brahmajñānamanvāno dīkṣāmeva śaraṇaṃ śrayatisūryaṃ divāgniṃ rātraudaridraṇānāpi vā cakṣuṣā gṛhītuṃ śakyaḥdīkṣe māmāhiṃsīritimāmāhiṃsīsaṃbhāvanayā vihvalamiva dṛṣṭvā tannirākaraṇopāyamupadiśatiretasi skanne punarmāmaitviṃdriyamiti japetpunarmāmaitviṃdriyamiti vimṛśet yathāsuprajasaṃ kurunirdhanaṃ pratipakṣoriśśaṃkaṃ sarvaṃ bhrājayatīti śivamatha cāturhotṛkavrataśikṣāupāsyā tat dvaitāpattiriti netyāhasahāsīthāḥcidavyatiriktatvādhyāpanāya | etadeva viṣadayatiekatamovā bhuṃjīthāḥiti śruteḥ | tatkṣaṃtavyamatigahanakarmamārgapravartavaurgurubhiḥekāśivādi sakalaparyaṃta sthiti saṃgataḥtatsvātaṃtryāt svataṃtratvamaśnuvānovabhāsatepramārūpatayā soyaṃ varṇādeti sarucyatepramāṇarūpatāveśamaparityajyameyatāmśuddhaprameyatā yoge satatvādhveti gṛhyatāṃśūnyatāmātraviśrāṃte nirānaṃdātmikā sthitiḥanaṃtameya saṃghadvāpūrṇe meye tu sarvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pramātā sarvameyau ca kalanā grāsake vidaḥtadā khalu cidānaṃdo yojaḍānupavṛṃhitaḥyatra kopi vyavacchedo nāsti tadviśvataḥ sphurattadeva jagadānaṃda dhāmāsmākaṃ gururjagaute brahmakṣatraviḍ śudrā nāmāno varṇasaṃjñitāḥutpāditā bhavatyeva ṣaḍvidhā anulomajāutpāditā bhavatyete ṣaḍvidhā pratilomajājanayaṃti sutānyetā jārajān viddhitān dvidhāanulomastu ṣaṭproktāḥ pratilomāśca tatsamāḥupavarṇāsamānastu yoṣisujanayaṃti cetanyathā jātisaṃkaryājjāyaṃte mlechajātayaḥpratilomāstu tacchiṣṭāstebhyaścāpyanulomajāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00576 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
